clarified_statement_proofs.scope: Finite CRT certificate count, with exact empty-block treatment and factor three charged per assigned prime, assuming the product <=2*n.
A fixed allocation of distinct primes to target blocks and offsets has count at most n^h*3^omega(r)/r. Product and exponent partition identities are proved.
Union over all block-and-offset assignments yields normalized count <=(3*h*(Q+1))^omega(r)/r on the independent Cartesian grid.
Actual normalized uniform probability on the Cartesian grid for all prime factors of the odd rough kernel at a fixed source vertex. The product-size condition r<=2*n remains explicit.
The actual kernel divides its source vertex; 0<m<=2*n discharges the product-size premise.
Literal z^omega(r)/r <=T^(-1+log(z)/log(Y)) for positive T<=r and 1<=z<Y, using actual rough-prime support.
Actual CRT hosting probability bounded by the threshold power for a fixed source occurrence.
A single support with nonempty rough kernels is private-pivot regular when Y>Q. All raw occurrences are retained in the definition.

A deterministic failure of regularity forces all rough primes at some source occurrence into other blocks. The final k*(Q+1) probabilistic union bound is supplied by RoughKernelCloudBound.regularity_probability_le.
Exposing any one uniform index and deleting that coordinate gives an injective finite-fibre bound, then exact averaging under the actual Cartesian-grid law.
Averaged all-prime CRT hosting estimate for a genuine source occurrence, with any larger weight z and no assumed conditional comparison.

Full multi-source probability bound (k*(Q+1))*T^(-1+log(3*k*(Q+1))/log(Y)) for all kernels >=T but failure of private-pivot regularity. Uses 0<n, Q<=n, Q<Y, T>0 and 3*k*(Q+1)<Y, as explicit ambient hypotheses.

Literal membership in the stronger good set, with the natural floor of the real threshold, discharges all individual kernel predicates. Together with the previous CRT allocation and single-support proofs, this closes G.2.
